title: Database Latency Spike & Connection Saturation
incident_summary: Order API p95 latency spiked above 2000ms with elevated 504 Gateway Timeouts impacting checkout flow. Users unable to place orders.
distractor_note: Payment service minor memory utilization variance at 10:22.

title: Deployment-Induced Order API Regression
incident_summary: Surge in HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors on order checkout endpoint immediately following mid-day service update.
distractor_note: Cache hit rate slight drop from 93% to 89% during cache warming.

title: Cache Degradation & Cascading Database Load
incident_summary: Order API and Database latencies increasing following abrupt cache miss spike across product and order session reads.
distractor_note: Inventory service background catalog sync at 09:15.

title: Inconclusive Signal & Telemetry Dropout
incident_summary: Sporadic 503 errors reported on Frontend, but telemetry metrics for upstream database show missing data and conflicting logs.
distractor_note: Missing database metrics and contradictory payment status codes.
